apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: New: Hips, Chris's daily hip mobility as one guided 17-minute session, boot on. Also Chris's updated routine, AM/PM isometrics, skip counts as done.

Chris's update: band plantarflexion joins the band superset; wall isometric is Chris's 3 × 3 × 15 s in the morning round and David's 4 × 30 s in the evening. Skipping counts as done; evening always starts a full round.
Skipping past an exercise counts it as done. An unfinished morning round no longer eats the evening one.
